title: Migrate Kanbus docs site (publish) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code migrated (Kanbus PR #527 merged: papyrus-newsroom 5.1.0, anthus-markus 0.13, site-url). NOT published: GitHub Pages is not enabled for AnthusAI/Kanbus (Pages API 404) and the deploy job is gated on DOCS_DEPLOY. To publish: set Pages source to GitHub Actions and DOCS_DEPLOY=true.
